patterns.note: Full-bleed sections alternate between solid color backgrounds and rich photographic imagery, creating distinct visual breaks and a sense of depth.

A dramatic contrast in typography is used, pairing oversized, bold serifs and elegant script fonts for primary branding and section titles with small, refined sans-serifs for navigation and body text.
The palette centers on a warm, sophisticated contrast between a deep, rich brown and a soft, light pinkish-beige, complemented by vibrant accent colors within photographic elements.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, enhancing visual flow.
The hero image employs a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the overlaying text and navigation.
Large, artistic script typography is integrated as a primary graphic element within full-width sections, often serving as a visual anchor or decorative overlay.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that transforms its background color and height as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal new content sections, where elements fade in and translate slightly upwards as they become visible in the viewport, leveraging css-keyframes.

The hero section features a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect, likely achieved with CSS transforms or canvas animation.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold serif and elegant script headings (~4-5x body) with small uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical spacing between full-bleed sections and balanced padding within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, artistic script typography as a central design element, often overlaid on full-bleed color blocks or images, creates a luxurious and editorial feel. This, combined with the rich, warm color palette and subtle motion, elevates the brand beyond a typical interior design portfolio.
